note.lineText: // The M061 SC4, SC2 surface: the token, the kind and the import path the provider entry the record carries names — or the absence that stands where no entry carries the token, or the two absences a record that names no formatter leaves — each in its own line, and no locale value, because the value is in no field this tree records.

route.statement: one entry of the `PANEL_SURFACES` list, spread into the `appRoutes` table by the one mapped literal the table ends with, lazy through the shared `loadPanelDemo` closure the table defines once, and naming its surface in `data.surface` as every demo-backed route does. It sits between `error-routing` and the `dead-click` note rather than after `what-changed`, for the reason the list’s own note states: the `m047..m060` route records cite the loader’s two lines, the path lines above the entry, the `dead-click` and `what-changed` path lines below it and the declaration and mapped-literal lines below the list, so the entry’s two lines are paid for by folding the M050 note’s four lines into two and every line those records cite keeps its number. The route registers nothing and measures nothing at render time: it reaches the pane that renders the join’s answer.

loader.statement: the `locale-correctness` key is one entry of the `LOADERS` map and it is the only path to `panel-locale-correctness.ts`: the demo looks the key up by the name the route’s `data.surface` states, awaits the dynamic import, calls the module’s default export with the sample fact, and sets the state and the lines the module answers. The key cost one line, and that line is paid for by folding the `fields` note’s last two lines into one, so the loader resolution block (717, 723–726), the component template and every earlier fact keep their numbers. The fact is the join’s own answer over the entries T001 measured: `state: locale-provider-entry`, the token the walk derived for the installed locale token, the kind that entry was declared with, the module it came from, two absences in the join’s own order and no claim — because no record this answer read carries an `artefactPath` — and `panel-demo.spec.ts` re-reads that record, evaluates the shipped join from its own committed text and holds this fact to that answer field for field.

answer.statement: the join answers `{ state, token, provider, importPath, absences, claims }` with every field in every state and no seventh. The demo’s sample is the `locale-provider-entry` answer: the token the walk derived, the kind `value`, the import path `AppConfig`, `locale-value-not-recorded` because the provided value is in no field the walk writes, `no-formatter-named` because no record in this tree names a formatter, and no claim, because a claim cites an `artefactPath` and no record this answer read carries one.

verdict: measured: the panel route `locale-correctness` is one lazy route — a `PANEL_SURFACES` entry spread into `appRoutes` by the one mapped literal, sitting between `error-routing` and the `dead-click` note and costing the list two lines the M050 note’s own fold pays for, so no line the route records cite moves — whose `data.surface` names the `locale-correctness` key of `panel-demo.ts`’s `LOADERS`, and that key is the only path to `panel-locale-correctness.ts`. The pane renders the join’s six fields and nothing it did not state: the token, the kind and the import path the entry the answer read carries, one line per absence the answer carries, and one pair of lines per claim it cites — with every `null` rendered as no line at all, so `locale-token-absent` shows the absence and never a default locale, and `formatted-outside-i18n` shows the two absences rather than the nearest locale a page renders. The pane names no locale value, no remedy, no cause, no schematic and no identity the answer did not carry, and it writes no sentence of its own: the digest gains no row and the copy record gains no sentence. The panel carries 32 surfaces, 32 loader keys and 41 ordered paths at this reading — M062’s T003 adds its own `outlet` surface, loader key and route to the three lists and adds no sentence to any pane — `extension/copy-digest.json` 204 rows with none of them this pane’s, and the copy record 31 surfaces and 213 sentences with this surface recorded by this file and the `outlet` pane by the second entry of the `surfaces` list below.
